retained_skill: Standardize a mixed chemical library, calculate molecular properties, apply Lipinski filtering, deduplicate standardized structures, and produce an SDF with usable 3D conformers.
bottleneck: The dominant obstacle is a broken verifier setup: all eight semantic checks call a helper that imports RDKit under /opt/verifier/bin/python, then tries that interpreter's nonexistent pip. Thus no submitted chemistry can pass. Attempts also spent early turns discovering and installing RDKit for their own scripts, but the scored failure is independent of their deliverables.
change: Repair in the environment: install a pinned RDKit build into the verifier interpreter during image construction and remove the verifier's ineffective runtime installation attempts. This preserves every chemistry requirement and gives no help with the retained skill; it only lets existing checks inspect submissions.
restore: No task difficulty is removed and no later restoration is needed. A later revision could only revert this after replacing it with another reliable way for the verifier interpreter to import RDKit.
prediction: Attempts that produce chemically valid SDFs will now reach all semantic checks instead of eight setup exceptions. This is refuted if a fresh replay still reports an RDKit import/setup failure, or if repaired grading shows that none of the submitted states satisfy the retained chemistry checks.
